purpose: Define predictable failure handling and graceful degradation across independent Nexus services.
rules: External service failures must not cascade into unrelated business modules.
Circuit breakers open only after a configured failure threshold.
Open circuits recover through a half-open probe after the reset timeout.
Each service has an explicit fallback behavior.
Fallback results must be marked partial or degraded rather than presented as complete.
Source systems are never mutated by resilience logic.
